tasks.short: Present and defend climate research proposals

steps.what: Read the actual climate-change research proposal, methods, budget and supporting evidence before its presentation
inputs: actual methods, budget and supporting evidence
outputs: analyst-checked proposal argument and evidence limits

steps.what: Present the actual climate-change research project proposal and explain its rationale, methods and intended contribution
inputs: analyst-checked proposal argument and evidence limits

steps.what: Defend the actual research proposal, answer challenges and explain uncertainty or unresolved objections
inputs: analyst-checked proposal argument and evidence limits
outputs: actual defended proposal and acknowledged limitations

tasks.design: Configure native proposal-to-evidence links in {DOCS} for actual presentation preparation. The analyst reads the proposal, presents it and handles live challenges; no extra presentation report, minutes or proposal submission is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated navigation to actual proposal evidence can interrupt preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native version/source links can shorten retrieval without inventing research arguments.
tasks.still_hard: Defending research validity requires understanding objections in context.
tasks.human_edge: Concede a genuine limitation while explaining why the proposed research still matters.

ambition.what: No automatic defence or increased funding success claim.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 for proposal and supporting evidence access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native proposal-evidence links can reduce preparation navigation while live research defence remains expert work.

assumptions: Shares are an unmeasured actual presentation/defence episode, not a measured baseline or the prompt prior.
The project team supplies the actual proposal, budget and methods; the analyst reads and checks them in s1. Missing justification remains a real limitation to resolve manually.
Only evidence navigation changes. Equivalent existing links remove the gain. Actual proposal writing is not added again to this presentation task.
Gross provisional saving 1 minus 0.5 hour of evidence-link upkeep gives 0.5 net. The episode has no separate file send or record commit.
unknowns: Repeated evidence retrieval during real presentation preparation
research_questions: Does native evidence linking reduce actual preparation work beyond existing document tools?

already_counted.description: Read and check proposal evidence before presenting

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 0.5%; actual presentation and defence remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare climate, environmental-management and sustainability grant applications

steps.what: Read actual grant call requirements, eligibility, required attachments and application questions
inputs: actual funder call and application form/version
outputs: analyst-checked application requirements and eligibility gaps

steps.what: Define the actual climate/environment/sustainability program case, activities, outcomes, budget justification and evidence
inputs: analyst-checked application requirements and eligibility gaps
actual program plans, cost estimates and team commitments
outputs: analyst's actual program case and checked grant evidence pack

steps.what: Draft the actual grant application responses from the checked program case and evidence
inputs: analyst's actual program case and checked grant evidence pack
actual funder questions and word limits

loop.purpose: Draft narrative grant responses from the actual program evidence
loop.input: checked program evidence pack and exact funder questions
loop.output: draft response text with supporting source references and explicit gaps
loop.check: Analyst checks every claim, commitment and number against actual evidence and funder requirements
loop.stop: Missing evidence, contradictory cost/commitment or unsupported outcome returns to manual authoring
loop.why_not_simpler: Fixed fields can fill identifiers and numbers but cannot phrase the program rationale for diverse narrative questions

steps.what: Complete and check the final grant application, budget consistency, attachments and unresolved authorisations
inputs: analyst's actual program case and checked grant evidence pack
analyst-checked application requirements and eligibility gaps
outputs: complete checked grant application draft for existing organisational authorisation

steps.what: Save the completed checked grant application draft in the existing application workspace
inputs: complete checked grant application draft for existing organisational authorisation

tasks.design: Configure native funder-question/checklist fields in {OTHER}, the grant reference/workspace application, before a bounded narrative draft in {DOCS}. The analyst supplies the actual program case and checks all claims and {SPREADSHEET} budget values before saving the prepared application; final organisational authorisation and funder submission remain separate existing actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Narrative responses must connect actual program evidence to varied funder questions.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded evidence-pack draft can propose prose while native fields handle fixed form structure.
tasks.still_hard: A credible funded program needs real commitments, feasible outcomes and a justified budget.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when persuasive prose overstates what the program can actually deliver.

ambition.what: No automatic application submission or grant-success increase claimed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-6 for program/budget access and authorised evidence processing

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded evidence-pack drafting can assist grant prose while real program commitments, budget consistency and final authorisation remain human responsibilities.

assumptions: Shares are provisional human application-preparation effort, not a measured drafting baseline or funding-success claim.

Funders supply actual requirements; program owners supply actual activities/commitments; finance supplies actual cost estimates. The analyst gathers and checks these in s1/s2; missing commitments cannot be generated.
Native fields/checklists address fixed structure first. The loop only drafts source-supported prose; data capture and all claim review remain counted in s2/s3/s4.
Gross provisional saving 11.75 minus 2 hours of call/template and draft-rule upkeep gives 9.75 net. The negligible save earns no gain.
Task ends with preparation. Saving the checked draft does not certify organisational commitments or send anything to a funder; those require existing authorised final-version processes.
unknowns: Actual evidence-pack completeness and drafting effort after review
research_questions: Does bounded drafting reduce real application effort after source capture and full claim verification?

already_counted.description: Inspect draft claims and complete/check the actual application

incremental.description: Maintain call fields and source-grounded narrative rules

approvals.approved_version: complete checked grant application draft for existing organisational authorisation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 9.75%; program design, source capture and final claim verification remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.ambitious_version: Reduce evidence navigation and application prose effort while retaining credible research defence and accountable program commitments.
